definitions.full: H8033. sham שָׁם adverb there, thither (Arabic there , compare then ; Biblical Aramaic תַּמָּה , Egyptian Aramaic תמה S-C Pap. A 4, J 6 , תַּמָּן ᵑ7 (with demonstrative n , compare אֱדַיִן beside אֲזַי ), Syriac ; Zenj Had. 8 (Cooke 159 ) שם ); — 1. a. there Gen 2:8 , 12 ; 11:2 , 7 , 31 + often; placed early in sentence for emphasis, Micah 4:10 תִּנָּצֵ֑לִי שָׁם , Nahum 3:15 ; Ezek 32:22 , 24 ; Psa 104:26 +, ֗֗֗ וְשָׁם Gen 41:12 ; Exod 15:27 ; Num 13:22 , 33 +, וְשָׁם ֗֗֗ שָׁם Exod 15:25 ; Deut 12:14 ; Isa 27:10 ; Job 3:17 +, ֗֗֗ שָׁם וְהִנֵּה Gen 29:2 , ֗֗֗ שָׁם כִּי 11:9 ; 21:31 ; 35:7 ; 2Sam 1:21 ; 15:21 +, ֗֗֗ שָׁם אַךְ Isa 34:14-15 , ֗֗֗ שָׁם גַּם 23:12 ; 57:7 ; Psa 139:10 ; resuming a preceding 'where,' Job 39:30 הוּא שָׁם חֲלָלִים בַּאֲשֶׁר , Judg 5:27 ; Jer 22:12 ; Eccl 11:3 , compare 1:7 . Repeated, שָׁם ֗֗֗ שָׁם here ... there Isa 28:10 , 13 . In poetry, pointing to a spot in which a scene is localized vividly in the imagination, Psa 14:5 פחד פחדו שׁם there feared they a fear! Psalm 36:13, compare 48:7 ; 66:6 ; 132:17 ; Hosea 6:7 ; Zeph 1:14 . — Hab 3:4 read probably (We Now) שָׂם the flashes at his side made he the hiding of his power; Eccl 3:17 שָׁם = with God , in the Divine plan or scheme: but read perhaps שָׂם Hi De and others b. preceded by the rel. , שָׁם אֲשֶׁר where , Gen 2:11 ; Exod 20:21 ; 1Sam 9:10 +, usually with one or more words between, Gen 13:3 , 14 ; 19:27 ; Exod 29:42 ; 2Sam 11:16 ; 2Kin 23:27 + often; after שָׁם הוּא בַּאֲשֶׁר בַּאֲשֶׁר, Gen 21:17 . With אשׁר omitted (the relative being indicated by construct, Ges § 130 c, d ) Ezek 39:11 ׳בְּיִשְׂר קֶבֶר שָׁם מְקוֺם a place where a grave (may be) in Israel, but ᵑ7 ᵐ5 Co Or and others read שֵׁם a place of renown. 2 thither , after verbs of motion ( = שָׁ֫מָּה , see 3 ), Deut 1:37 שָׁם תָבאֹ לֹא , Judg 19:15 ; 21:10 ; 1Sam 2:14 ; 9:6 and elsewhere; שָׁם ֗֗֗ אֲשֶׁר whither , 1Kin 18:10 ; 21:18 ; 2Kin 1:4 , 6 , 16 ; Isa 20:6 , more often in Jeremiah, Ezekiel, as Jer 8:3 ; 22:27 ; 23:3 , 8 ; 45:5 +, Ezek 4:13 ; 12:16 ; 36:20 , 22 +; so שֶׁשָּׁם Psa 122:4 . 3 with ה locative, שָׁ֫מָּה ( sh¹mm¹h ): a. after verbs of motion , thither , Gen 19:20 שָׁ֫מָּה לָנוּס to flee thither , 19:22 ; 20:13 ; 24:6 ; 29:3 ; Deut 1:38 + often; = into it, therein (of a basket, pit, etc.), Exod 16:33 הָעֹמֶר מְלֹא וְתֶןשָֿׁ֫מָּה , 21:33 שָׁמָּה וְנָפַל , 30:18 ; Judg 8:25 ; 2Kin 12:10 ; pregnantly, after a verb implying motion, as to bury , Gen 23:13 שָׁ֫מָּה אֶתמֵֿתִי וְאֶקְבְּרָה , 25:10 ; 49:31 ; 50:5 (all P), נוֺעַד to meet Exod 29:42-43 , 30:6 , 36 ; Numbers 17:19 (all P), Josh 2:16 ; 7:3 ; Jer 13:7 ; Joel 4:7, perhaps Song 8:5 (? c ). b. שָׁ֫מָּה ֗֗֗ אֲשֶׁר whither Gen 20:13 ; Num 33:54 ; Deut 4:5 , 14 + often; where 2Kin 23:8 ; 1Chr 4:41 . c. more rarely , i. q. שָׁם there , Gen 43:30 שָׁ֫מָּה וַיֵּבְךְ , Josh 2:1 ; Judg 16:27 ; 2Kin 4:11 ; 9:16 ; Hosea 2:17 ; Isa 22:18 ; 34:15 ; 65:9 ; Jer 18:2 ; 27:22 ; Ezek 23:3 ; 32:29-30 , ( 32:22 ; 32:24 ; 32:26 שָׁם ), 48:35 ׳י שָׁ֫מָּה , Psa 76:4 ; 122:5 ; Eccl 3:16 . 4 מִשָּׁם from there, thence: a. often after verbs of departing, taking, etc., Gen 2:10 ; 11:8-9 , 12:8 ; 18:16 ; 24:7 ; 42:2 , etc., Num 13:23 ; 21:12 ; 22:41 מִשָּׁם וַיַּרְא , Deut 4:29 מִשָּׁם וּבִקַּשְׁתֶּם , 30:4 ; Jer 37:12 ; Hosea 2:17 ; Amos 9:2-3 , 4 ; Job 39:29 +. Peculiarly, Gen 49:24 יִשְׂר אֶבֶן רֹעֶה ׳מִשָּׁם Ges De RVm from there [from heaven], (from) the Shepherd ( ׳י ), the Stone (Rock) of Israel, Ew Di Sta from there (where is) the Shepherd of ( רֹעֵה ) the (Bethel-)stone of Israel; but both forced: text dubious; Gunk by the name ( מִשֵּׁם ; so ᵑ6 ) of the Shepherd, etc. (as Ew Di). b. מִשָּׁם ֗֗֗ אֲשֶׁר whence Gen 24:5 ; Num 23:13 +. c. expressing origin , Gen 3:23 the ground מִשָּׁם לֻקַּח אֲשֶׁר , 10:14 whence (= from whom ) came forth the Philistines, Judg 19:18 אָנֹכִי מִשָּׁם , 1Sam 10:12 מִשָּׁם אִישׁ , Isa 65:20 . d. of the mass , from which something is taken or made, Gen 27:9 ; 30:32 (of צאֹן ), Lev 2:2 זגו מִשָּׁם ׳וְקָמַץ (from the meal, etc., of a מנחה ), 1Kin 17:13 קְטַנָּה עֻגָה מִשָּׁם לִי עֲשִׁי אַךְ i.e. from the meal and oil, 2Kin 7:2 , 19 תאֵֹכל׃ לֹא וּמִשָּׁם , Ezek 5:3 .
